This is the default Notra Sites blog. It uses the same theme and settings as a new site, with a few sample posts so you can see how everything looks before publishing your own writing.

## Start with a post

Create a Markdown or MDX file in `blog/`. Add a title, description and date at the top, then write the body below the frontmatter.

```yaml
---
title: "Our first story"
description: "What we are building and why."
date: 2026-10-18
author: team
tags: [Company]
---
```

The file name becomes the post's slug. With the blog mounted at `/blog`, `blog/our-first-story.mdx` is published at `/blog/our-first-story`.

## Make it your own

Change the site name and descriptions in `blog.json`. The `authors` section defines the people you can reference from a post's `author` field.

You don't need to choose colors, fonts or a layout to publish. Leave those settings out to use the platform defaults, or add them later when you're ready to match your brand.

## Publish an update

Commit your changes to the branch connected to your site. Notra builds the content from your repository and publishes the deployment.

Replace this post with your own introduction when you're ready.
